verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code review and governance platform, so shipping official SDKs is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence documents only an Agentic Toolbox CLI, an MCP server, and agent plugins (Claude, Codex, Kiro), none of which is a language SDK. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so the pack shows no official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
